basic_details.job_title: RITES Retired Govt/PSU Employees Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: RITES Limited needs retired Government and PSU employees on contract basis on fixed remuneration under Vacancy Circular VC No. 86/26 (E). The circular was announced on 17 November 2026, and the last date is 23 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Retired Government or PSU employees who want to apply must do so by 23 November 2026. The available notice does not mention the mode of application, an application form or a postal or email address. The official notification PDF and the RITES website, listed below, are the places to find these details.

content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the amount of remuneration, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited issued this requirement as Vacancy Circular VC No. 86/26 (E). The circular was published in both Hindi and English and seeks the services of persons who have retired from Government or PSU service.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The circular is addressed to retired Government employees and retired PSU employees. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the experience required or the age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each position.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected retirees will be engaged on a contract basis and paid a fixed remuneration. The amount of the remuneration and the length of the contract are not specified in the notice.
